title: 📱 Mobile App Updates Part 2
body:
🏠 Home Page - Quick Access Section
Admin-Controlled Categories:

The Quick Access section on the home page is now fully controlled from the admin panel
Categories you mark as "Quick Access" will automatically appear here
Display order matches the order you set in the admin panel
Changes sync in real-time—no app restart needed
📍 Multi-Location Support (NEW!)
Products can now be assigned to multiple store locations, and the app handles this intelligently:

Location Display on Product Details:

Online Only - If a product has no physical store locations, a blue "Online Only" tag is displayed
Single Location - If available at one store, the location name is shown
Multiple Locations - If available at multiple stores, users see a dropdown to select their preferred pickup location
This prepares the app for future features like location-based inventory and store pickup options.

📂 Category Pages - Image Support
Custom Category Images:

Category pages now display the custom images uploaded through the admin panel
Supports both standard images and base64 encoded images
Images load smoothly with caching to prevent flickering
⚡ Performance & Stability
Real-Time Updates:

The app now receives live updates when inventory or categories change
No need to pull-to-refresh—new products and category changes appear automatically
Image Performance:

Added image caching to prevent repeated loading
Smooth transitions when images load (no more flickering)

Note: All data in the videos are test data for testing pure functionality
Please review the release notes section to see the part 1 post.
